title: Care-Stay Share Stated on the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
Larkspur care stays charged in the window of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** annual tax letter are stated as medical expense at a care-stay share: where the window holds any Post-Hospital Recovery Stay nights the share is 1.0, where it holds Assisted Living Respite Stay or Memory Care Respite Stay nights but no recovery nights the share is 0.6, and otherwise the share is 0; the share applies to the stay nightly charges counted, as the resident bore them.

The stay nightly charges are those of Larkspur care stays, every stay type other than the Independent Living Trial Stay. The care-stay portion so obtained is added to the letter's medical expense amount before its single rounding to the cent half up.

## Records read

Nightly charge entries on the resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger within the letter's window, by the stay type billed: Post-Hospital Recovery Stay; Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care), (Enhanced Care) or (Extensive Care); Memory Care Respite Stay.

## Share ladder

| Nights in the window | Care-stay share |
|---|---|
| Any Post-Hospital Recovery Stay nights | 1.0 |
| Assisted Living or Memory Care Respite Stay nights and no recovery nights | 0.6 |
| Neither | 0 |

## Hypothetical windows

| Nights held | Share | Charges borne | Care-stay portion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 recovery nights and 6 assisted living respite nights | 1.0 | 4800.00 | 4800.00 |
| 6 memory care respite nights only | 0.6 | 2700.00 | 1620.00 |
| Independent Living Trial Stay nights only | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
